[DST] Limbus Company Characters 边狱巴士
作者：魔犬
码师：zzzzzzzs
画师：伊尹、鬼针、maotuki、finn
文案：马一甲（谷）
赞助鸣谢：伊尹、maotuki

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

更详细的MOD介绍请访问：https://www.bilibili.com/opus/989683691940741121

本MOD基于韩国残酷罪孽共鸣RPG游戏《Limbus Company》，包含8名罪人角色。角色介绍具体如下：

10.但丁：
样貌神秘的管理者，可以复活罪人们的“时钟”——祂虽无法进食普通食物，入夜后，却会成为罪人们不可或缺的明灯。
1.李箱：
成为标本的天才，是诗人也是发明家——可靠而稳定的团队智囊，维系各方平衡的全能手（*该人物拥有两件带有特殊功能的专属套装）；
2.浮士德：
与恶魔签订契约，无所不知的博士——虽然更加脆弱易折，却拥有掌握黑暗力量的能力。
3.唐吉诃德：
满怀冒险与骑士精神，狂热的收尾人粉丝——热衷于收集收尾人勋章的她，通过模仿偶像的扮演游戏，拥有着独特的强大力量（*该人物拥有两件带有特殊功能的专属套装）
5.默尔索：
静默，细致。冷漠，温柔。局外人——擅长使用所有厨具烹饪任何食物的大厨，同时拥有更高的攻击倍率。（*该人物拥有两件带有特殊功能的专属套装）
6.鸿璐：
异花映月明，气贵自生荣。玉眼通幽暗，轻力扰浮华——具有夜视功能的贵公子，意外擅于战斗，却不善耕织。（*该人物拥有两件带有特殊功能的专属套装）
7.希斯克里夫：
怀揣复仇之心，来自荒原的狂野之人——拥有特殊的复仇机制：在更低的血量与san值下，攻击将会变得更加迅猛强烈（*该人物拥有两件带有特殊功能的专属套装）
13.格里高尔：
存活至今的退役军人，无法遮盖、令人厌恶的身体变形——拥有无法拆卸、永久占有武器栏的虫肢。同时拥有特殊的san值与饥饿度特性。（*该人物拥有两件带有特殊功能的专属套装）

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This MOD is based on the Korean RPG game "Limbus Company," featuring eight sinner characters. The character introductions are as follows:

10、Dante:
 A mysterious manager who can revive sinners with his "clock"—though he cannot consume ordinary food, he becomes an indispensable beacon for sinners at night.
1、Yi Sang: 
A genius turned specimen, both a poet and an inventor—he is the reliable and stable team brain, a versatile hand that maintains balance among all parties (This character has two exclusive outfits with special functions).
2、Faust: 
A doctor who has made a pact with a demon and knows all—though more fragile, he possesses the ability to wield dark powers.
3、Don Quixote: 
A passionate adventurer and fanatic of the Reapers—she collects Reaper medals with fervor, gaining unique strength through her idol mimicry role-playing game (This character has two exclusive outfits with special functions).
5、Meursault:
 Silent, meticulous; cold yet gentle—a bystander—he is a master chef capable of cooking any dish with all kitchen tools and has a higher attack multiplier (This character has two exclusive outfits with special functions).
6、Honglu: 
"Exotic flowers reflect the moonlight, nobility arises naturally. Jade eyes penetrate the darkness, gentle power disrupts the superficial."—A noble with night vision capabilities, unexpectedly skilled in combat, but poor at farming and weaving (This character has two exclusive outfits with special functions).
7、Heathcliff:
 A wild man from the moors, driven by vengeance—he possesses a unique revenge mechanism: with lower health and sanity, his attacks become more ferocious and intense (This character has two exclusive outfits with special functions).
13、Gregor:
 A retired soldier who has survived, with an unhideable, repulsive body transformation—he has unremovable, permanently equipped insect limbs, along with special sanity and hunger characteristics (This character has two exclusive outfits with special functions).

Hello survivors, welcome to our world, may the spirits be with you… For our world is filled with many dangers, many challenges, all waiting for you.

Get ready for your adventure to start, pick up your blades or your garden hoes and get ready to step into this magical world of Myth Characters!

Will you choose to run through the world carelessly as the great and dynamic Monkey King himself?

With the aid of his magical cudgel the world is your oyster; either you’ll be obliterating your opponents with quick attacks which summon your trusty clones, or you’ll be exploring the world.

Just make sure to farm up the food, for this piggy is a hungry one!

With necromancy and elegance on her side, nothing will be a threat to your greatness. And if anything is, just retreat into the mist, never to be seen again…

Or become a beautiful lady and dwell in these lands carelessly.

What about gracefully tearing down your opponents with precise attacks and ranged dominance, as well as being able to protect yourself with the powers of the mystical lotus flowers as the mighty prince NeZha?

With range and impeccable defense at your disposal, you will be the victor in every fight, maybe not a king, but a prince nonetheless.

And the last, but certainly not the least, we have the Three Eyed God himself. A man whose poise and regal manners portray a true deity. But don’t mistake his regal grace for weakness, otherwise you’ll be met pain worse than a thousand lightning.

With the trusty Sky Dog to help him survive( and keep him company) and his magnificent Fork Spear, any enemy in their path will be met with an electrifying demise, for his Fork Spear holds the power of pure lightning.

Now survivors, are you ready…? For your adventure to begin.

publishedfiledetails.title: Weetie (Character Mod)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Adds Weetie, a scatterbrained, happy-go-lucky bee. Featuring a unique voice and abilities (also unique quotes, but they're not fully finished).

This mod is also compatible with [API] Mods in Menu and [API] Modded Skins. Weetie currently has 2 additional skins.

[h1]Stats[/h1] 
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗶𝗴𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲. 𝗗𝗲𝗳𝗮𝘂𝗹𝘁 𝘀𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗻𝗲𝘄 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗿𝘀.

Health - 80

Sanity - 150

Hunger - 120

[h1] Abilities [/h1] 

[b] Bee me, Me bee [/b] 
- Weetie can gather pollen scattered on random objects to increase his unique Pollen Meter. Pollen passively spawns around Weetie when there's pollen producers nearby, like flowers and various other plants.
- Most Bees are passive to Weetie, Bees will also aggro onto your attackers if they are close.
- Pollen effects described in detail below, generally, Weetie gets stronger with more pollen, at the cost of hunger drain.
- Weetie can spend 20 pollen to heal other players for 20 HP and Max HP

[b] Pollen Banks [/b] 
- Gathered pollen can be stored in pollen banks (Bee Boxes, Beehives and the Gigantic Beehive).
- Depositing pollen into pollen banks that are already full will cause them to Overflow, which produces honey (and potentially other useful items). The drops and amount of Overflow needed differs per pollen bank.
- Bee Boxes are the only pollen bank that produces pollen (at 10 per day), with a cap of 100, and overflow ratio of 25.
  Beehives have a cap of 50, with an overflow ratio of 50.
  Gigantic Beehive has a cap of 20, with an overflow ratio of 80.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yXOJDcD.png[/img]

[b] Pollen Effects [/b] 
From 10 to 80 pollen, Weetie gets a speed buff of up to +30%
From 20 to 80 pollen, Weetie gets damage absorption of up to 25%
From 20 to 80 pollen, Weetie gets a hunger drain multiplier of up to +30%
From 20 to 80, Weetie gets an efficiency buff to all his work actions of up to 200%
From 80 pollen, Weetie gets the same honey trail effect as Bee Queen
From 80 to 100 pollen, Weetie gains health regen of up to 4hp every 4 seconds
At 100 pollen, Weetie gains a passive sanity aura inverse

[b] Scatterbrain [/b] 
- Short attention span, and generally being really careless, makes Weetie forget the recipes he learns after a short while (unless learnt via blueprints).
- Weetie cannot make map progress on his own.
- Weeties inventory gets shuffled on load or whenever the screen fades to black.
- Weetie has a random sanity modifier that constantly changes, ranging from -2.5 to +2.5

[b] Sweet-Eater [/b]
- Weetie prefers eating only sweet foods, getting only 40% of the benefits from non-honey foods.

[b] Misc [/b]
- Weetie takes more damage from freezing.
- His favorite food is Powdercake.

For a more in-depth look at Weeties mechanics, check out https://dontstarvetogethermods.wiki.gg/wiki/Weetie

[h1] Unique Crafts [/h1]

𝘽𝙚𝙚𝙥𝙧𝙞𝙣𝙩
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HJWtaQy.png[/img]
- Obtained by trading Royal Bees (a rare Overflow drop) to the Gigantic Bee Hive
- Unlocks one of Weeties unique recipes

𝙃𝙤𝙣𝙚𝙮-𝙋𝙤𝙩
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pSZ1iAt.png[/img]
- A portable 6 slot container
- Slow down spoilage by 25%
- Stores ANYTHING!

𝘽𝙚𝙚𝙝𝙞𝙫𝙚
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dNsHUW3.png[/img]
- Standard Beehive, but now craftable and renewable

𝙆𝙞𝙡𝙡𝙚𝙧 𝘽𝙚𝙚 𝙃𝙞𝙫𝙚𝙨
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FbvdD9E.png[/img]
- Plain old Killer Bee Hives
- But you get to craft them now
- Weetie has the ability to Rile Up any Killer Hives, making them aggro onto the nearest creature

[h1] Character Interactions [/h1]

[b] Welina [/b]
- When Welina and Weetie are within 1 tile of each other, all the damage Welina takes is instead taken by Weetie. 
- Welina will still reflect the full damage she would've taken and gain the full stacks of resentment towards the attacker.
- Weetie can wear all of Welinas collars
- Their friendship may be one-sided!

[b] Whisky [/b]

𝙒𝙝𝙞𝙨𝙠-𝙒𝙧𝙖𝙥𝙨
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MzCQOBp.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/lOqgVyc.png[/img]
- When Whisky is enabled alongside Weetie, he will be able to craft the Whisk-Wraps
- Whisk-Wraps can bundle up to 9 items, take it or leave it!


More Weetie, concepts and all that can be found on my newgrounds https://scotchmints.newgrounds.com/

publishedfiledetails.title: Whisky (Character Mod)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
A mod that adds Whisky, a not so ordinary depth dweller. Featuring 4 unique skins, full speech, voice and spider abilities.

[b] This mod will crash if used without [API] Modded Skins[/b] and it is also compatible with [API] Mods in Menu.


[h1] Stats [/h1]
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗶𝗴𝘂𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲. 𝗗𝗲𝗳𝗮𝘂𝗹𝘁 𝘀𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗻𝗲𝘄 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗿𝘀.

Health - 80

Sanity - 100

Hunger - 120

[h1] Abilities [/h1] 

[b] Chronic Back Pain[/b] 
- Whisky can't wear anything except amulets on her body slot.
- She will drop heavy objects like marble sculptures after carrying them for a short while (unless on a beefalo).

[b] Agile [/b] 
- Whisky moves slightly faster.
- She can also leap if she's holding a weapon. Leaping will consume a small amount of hunger.

[b] Sensitive Eyes [/b] 
- Being a cave spider, Whisky also doesn't like sunlight and loses sanity during the day.
- She doesn't lose sanity at night and dusk and regens sanity in caves.

[b] Monster [/b]
- Attacked on sight by creatures that hate spiders.
- She can eat monster meat with no penalties.

[b] Mushtree Enthusiast [/b] 
- Whisky can use silk yarns to cover blue mushtrees in web and spawn a dweller den. 
- She can shave webbed mushtrees to return them to normal and remove any dens from under them.

[b] Spider Tamer [/b] 
- She can befriend spiders.
- Has access to Webbers crafts.

[b] Misc [/b]
- She has lower attack
- Her favorite foods are red shrooms. 
- Whisky randomly weaves silk when nervous.
- She can eat fireflies.

[h1] Unique Crafts [/h1]

𝙎𝙞𝙡𝙠 𝙔𝙖𝙧𝙣 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R20ySBC.png[/img]
- An ingredient used in all of her recipes. 
- Can be used for sewing clothes (restores 3 times the amount sewing kits do). 
- Is also a healing item, restores 40 hp when used.

𝙁𝙡𝙤𝙥𝙥𝙮 𝙎𝙪𝙣 𝙃𝙖𝙩 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4GOOEMN.png[/img]
- Gives strong protection against heat.
- 80% rain protection.
- Lasts 6 days

𝙇𝙞𝙜𝙝𝙩 𝘽𝙪𝙡𝙗 𝙍𝙞𝙗𝙗𝙤𝙣
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pv9mPjC.png[/img]
- A ribbon that makes light when worn.
- Makes you pretty.
- Lasts 5 days

𝙎𝙪𝙣𝙜𝙡𝙖𝙨𝙨𝙚𝙨 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yHVWVl6.png[/img]
- Give a large sanity regen.
- Let you freely walk through sandstorms.
- Last for 6 days.

𝙒𝙝𝙞𝙨𝙠𝙮 𝙈𝙖𝙨𝙠 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yyTndpd.png[/img]
- Spiders will stay passive towards anyone wearing this item .
- Lasts for 3 days.

𝙎𝙞𝙡𝙠 𝙒𝙧𝙖𝙥𝙨 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙎𝙞𝙡𝙠 𝘽𝙪𝙣𝙙𝙡𝙚𝙨 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IDXkbKM.png[/img]
- Bundle stuff up.
- Work the same as gift wraps.

[h1] Extra Crafts [/h1]
(Items i found didn't fit the balance of the mod, but implemented because some people might still find them fun. Can be found and enabled in her configs, but disabled by default.)

𝙎𝙞𝙡𝙠 𝙋𝙤𝙪𝙘𝙝
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2A3t30I.png[/img]
- A backpack that ignores Whiskys back pain downside.
- Can only carry spiders and spider related items.
- Slightly slows down spoilage.

𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙒𝙝𝙞𝙥𝙨𝙠𝙮
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RTy5F5c.png[/img]

publishedfiledetails.title: Luna - Playable Character Mod
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Before Downloading:[/h1]

"Mods In Menu" Is not a required mod, since a lot of people have compatibility issues with it, I personally did not have any issues with it, BUT, if you want to be safe, or to play with other big mods enabled, don't download it. Disclaimer aside, if you're NOT using other big mods, enabling "Mods in Menu" enables you to check out all Luna skins in the Curio cabinet, enable and disable the custom Vignettes artworks, alongside some QOL stuff that make the mod feel complete!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2415978456][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1742303610499018002/A41CC0C1EB6D052FE85FD5DA630A1B2F305D6D1C/?imw=100&imh=100&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=true[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812783478&searchtext=modded+skins][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1849303175004231192/53AE45F2DC5BEFD3306BBBE324E51837631FB5C6/?imw=100&imh=100&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

[i][h3]About luna:[/h3][/i][list]
[*][b][i]Luna is a bunny girl,[/i][/b] from the race of the bunnymen.
[*][b][i]Luna has direct connection with the moon,[/i][/b] she doesn't understand why or how, however, that does make her special, allowing her to transform in a total diferent lunar form, and also making her have magical skills that help her survival in the inhospitable world of the constant.
[*][b][i]Luna basic stats are:[/i][/b][list]
 [*]150 Hunger
 [*]200 Lunar Sanity
 [*]150 Health[/list]
[*][b][i]Starts with the following items:[/i][/b][list]
 [*] Carrot
 [*] Sweet flute[/list]
[*][b][i]Passive skills:[/i][/b]
Luna has mutiple simple passive skills[list]
 [*]Just like other survivors, luna also has a favorite food, carrots! those give +15 extra hunger points to her, besides that, she also receives 33% more hunger points for any vegetarian food, just like wurt. Also receives 30% more health with any type of food she can eat.
 [*]Luna also does not make any prey creature run away from her, like rabbits, butterfly and other small little creatures.
 [*]Luna deals -10% less damage[/list]

[*][b][i]Luna Passive Transformation:[/i][/b]
Along with her passive abilities, Luna has the newest and most important one: 
 [b][u]Her Transformation[/u][/b][list]
 [*]Luna received a major update, giving her lunar sanity, which means that when it reaches above 100, she transforms, dealing 60% more damage and running 20% ​​faster. However, while transformed, Gestalts will try to force her to remain in her form by attacking her, which can certainly be very annoying to deal with. 
In addition, she will constantly lose 0.1% sanity, so even if Gestalts increase her sanity when they attack her, she will still have some slight problems maintaining her form.

[*][b][i]Craftings:[/i][/b]
Luna has some exclusive crafts, these are her main skills![list]
 [*][u]Witches carrat:[/u]
Her own hat, has 80% damage reduction, 400 hp.
It costs:[list]
 [*]8 Carrots
 [*]1 Rope
 [*]1 Petal[/list]
 [*][u]Magical Shepherd staff:[/u]
A Magical Lunar staff, that shoots bouncy projectiles just like the brightshade staff, deals 35 flat damage and 35 planar damage, 70 total damage (66 damage since Luna deals 10% less damage, the planar damage is not reduced). 75 uses.
It costs:[list]
 [*]4 Ropes
 [*]1 Living logs
 [*]10 Carrots[/list]
 [*][u]Sweet flute:[/u]
Luna enjoys spending time with her bunnymen friends, so she created the sweet flute! A flute that works just like the pan flute, making anyone sleep in the area, but for bunnymen the flute is a sweet melody for the ears, making any bunnymen in range follow Luna, helping her in battle, or, maybe to just spend some good time together.
It costs:[list]
 [*]4 Ropes
 [*]1 Lune tree blossom
 [*]5 Carrots
 [*]5 Jet feather[/list]
 [*][u]Transmutation Armor:[/u]
Luna has her own armor, the "Transmutation Armor" When worn, her sanity will cease to be lunar, allowing her to confront shadow monsters. Furthermore, she can still transform while wearing it, which prevents gestalts from attacking her.
It costs:[list]
 [*]1 Living Logs
 [*]1 Red Gem
 [*]4 Hounds Tooth[/list][/list][/list]

[hr][/hr]
[i][h2]Disclaimers / Warnings:[/h2][/i]
Luna's transformation only works when her sanity is above 100. Using a nightmare amulet, or using the enlightened crown buffed with celestial jewels, will not affect the transformation buffs, even if she changes her build. To explain it more clearly, if you have 200 sanity and use the nightmare amulet, even if Luna visually changes to her normal form, she will still have the buffs from her lunar form, because internally the sanity status remains the same, and the same happens with the enlightened crown.

(Another possible important warning is that if you change Luna's skin while she is transformed, the build will be replaced by the skin you changed to, but she will still retain the buffs. It's just a visual bug, but if you go to the caves or detransform and transform again, the build will revert to her transformed build.)

[b][u]ALL[/u][/b] the designs, sprites and artwork in general was made by [b][u]me![/u][/b].
There was [b][u]NO[/u][/b] AI involved in the making of this mod.
[i][h3][u]ALWAYS prioritize people and not generative art.[/u][/h3][/i]
English is not my main languague, typos are possible within Luna's quotes (which aren't complete for now)
If you spot any grammar mistakes please let me know!

[hr][/hr]
[i][h2]About me:[/h2][/i]
This mod originally had no intention of going so far: [b]Don't Starve[/b] is by far my favorite game since I was a child (Im very hyperfocused on it since then), I really loved being able to create something new and completely mine, so I kept going and going.
I really want to add new and interesting mechanics to the character but I just really don't know how to go further than this, and I'm very anxious on asking help to people I don't know.

If you want to help I would be very grateful. I need help with how to create skilltrees, how to make rabbits not run away without having to carry a carrot and how to make weapons with unique projectiles.

In case someone is interested in anything I did on this mod that is related to art (drawings , sprites, etc) my contact email is:
[i][u][h3]lulucontatoo@gmail.com[/h3][/u][/i] :D
I can make anything that involves the artistic part
Like I said I can't do anything more that I already did with this mod in terms of coding
Or in case you want art of anything that is not related to mods, I am completely open to commissions.
[i][u][b]No nsfw, gore or stuff like that[/b][/u][/i]

[hr][/hr]
[i][h1]Special thanks:[/h1][/i][list]
[*][i][u][b]Mewzuw[/b][/u][/i] - For making the sound effects of luna talking and her flute tune
[*][i][u][b]Wilson[/b][/u][/i] - For asking help to other people in the discord and forum about how to code the mod and helping with ideas that are in the mod now
[*][i][u][b]Miz[/b][/u][/i] - Being the only person that I really had the courage of asking something , helping me imensely to understand how to make icons of the vignettes work out in the curio cabinet, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/mizartz/myworkshopfiles/]check out their work at the Workshop too![/url]

[*][i][u][b]YOU[/b][/u][/i] - and my thanks to you! for looking at my mod , I hope you like it as much as I loved making every little thing in it, I hope to continue!

[h3][i]And with all of that said, have fun and Don't Starve!!![/i][/h3]

- Thanks to her spiky fashion, when hit Welina reflects 6 times the amount of damage taken back to her attacker.

- Welina has strong resistance against negative sanity auras.

[b] Resentful [/b] 
- Harboring a deep hatred for those who wronged her, 40% of all the damage she takes from a mob, will be directly added to her own attack power against the same mob that dealt the damage to her, lasting until the mob dies.

[b] Soggy Cat [/b]
- Welina hates being wet and will suffer sanity drain, slower work, and damage penalty depending on how wet she is. 
- Welina will refuse to sleep if she is wet.

[b] Misc [/b]
- Welina can eat stale and spoiled food with no penalties. She can also consume Horrible type foods.
- She can eat garbage, which will make her vomit other (potentially) useful items.
- Welina can play with stuff on ground for a small sanity boost.
- Always lands on her feet
